issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: First Feeding Our Future Defendant Sentenced to 12 Years in Prison
supports: Mohamed Jama Ismail was sentenced to 144 months in prison and three years of supervised release.
Ismail was ordered to pay $47,920,514 in restitution.
does_not_support: The restitution order is not proof that $47,920,514 has been collected.
The release does not establish that identical restitution amounts imposed on co-defendants are independent and additive.
